intro: Intro of Settings › Connected agents: external AI agents (Claude Code is a product name; don't translate it) that act in Socio for the person. {{command}} is a terminal command (code); keep the tags around it.
listLabel: Accessible name of the list of connected agents.
disconnect: Button: ends an external agent's access at once.
used: Line under a connected agent. {{connected}} and {{used}} are dates and times, or "never".
never: Stands in for a date in "last used …" when the agent never acted.
confirmTitle: Title of the confirmation before disconnecting. {{agent}} is the agent's label.
disconnected: Toast after disconnecting. {{agent}} is the agent's label.
